meta.title: Approvals Dashboard: refused for a user without the Approver role
gaps: Sign in as the non-Approver and Approver personas, open the Approvals Dashboard, verify the mine/upcoming/completed/rejected buckets and filters, and compare refused or absent access with available access.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as the non-Approver and Approver personas, open the Approvals Dashboard, verify the mine/upcoming/completed/rejected buckets and filters, and compare refused or absent access with available access.

args.need: sign in as the non-Approver and Approver personas on the same tenant, open the Approvals Dashboard, and compare whether access and its buckets and filters are refused or available

steps.note: The catalog cannot switch to or authenticate as these personas or observe the Approvals Dashboard.
Assert that the resulting screen has no crash, server error, or raw error state after the tester performs the comparison.
